name: Cherryh
description: A world with a toxic native biosphere; people live in domed surface habitats.

name: Nauzika
description: A lush world orbiting a binary star, where three species evolved side by side.

name: Sturm
description: A heavy-metal-tainted hothouse of micro-continents and archipelagos, first settled as Saloum.

name: Garibaldi
description: Once an imperial power and the breadbasket of Extremadura; now the 'Valkyriate Garibaldi', with an active resistance.

name: Vanir
description: A frozen volcanic world on a trade chokepoint. The Home Fleet holds Vanadis; the capital district is Vanaheim.

name: Mayerling
description: An alpine world of inland seas and lakes, and a resort for the wealthy.

name: Azadestan
description: The 'Valkyriate Azadestan': a Chosen client in an uneasy ceasefire with the locals.

name: Lycia
description: A warm, rugged, Earthlike world split three ways between rival powers.

name: Placidia
description: A tideless ocean world under a dim star, where Terran and native life are clashing.

name: Hebonaidd
description: Still scarred by a nuclear war a century before the USN arrived.

name: Caxias
description: The 'Valkyriate Caxias': a Chosen puppet state where local factions are fighting back.

name: Han Shan
description: The Combined Republic of Han Shan-Azania: two rival colonial governments sharing one world. Far Stars Federation member.

name: Atalanta
description: The United Queenly Republics of Atalanta, a Far Stars Federation member.

name: Nouvelle Liberte
description: The People's Federation of Nouvelle Liberté, a newborn democracy after junta rule and Far Stars Federation member. Its state arms company is SFA Mfecane.

name: Mu
description: A borderline world that has only just finished a century of terraforming. Its twin moons host bases and stations.

name: Bamberia
description: A fertile plantation world exporting tobacco and fruit.

name: Velyke Nebo
description: The Republic of Velyke Nebo, a unitary presidential democracy and Far Stars Federation member; birthplace of Mriya Interstellar Aerospace.

name: al-Majid
description: The al-Majid Spaceport Authority, a Far Stars Federation member.

name: Refuge
description: Its surface is held by automated defences; its people live in fortified vaults.

name: Montana
description: Tectonically active and rich in minerals, with a modest population.

name: Chengdu
description: The Chengdu Planetary Union, a technocratic centralised state and Far Stars Federation member.

name: Far Away
description: The Free State of Far Away, a loose federation and the oldest human state in the Cluster. Far Stars Federation member.

name: Fuso
description: The Kingdom of Fuso, a corporate constitutional monarchy and Far Stars Federation member.

name: Ctesibius
description: A partitioned world: the Universities hold the campus territories, rival states the rest.

name: Decatur
description: The Decatur Riparian Authority, a confederation and Far Stars Federation member.

name: Bellevue
description: The Gubierno Cibil de Bellevue, a constitutional monarchy and core world of the Far Stars Federation.

name: Abzu
description: A storm-wracked pre-garden world with arcology cities, rich in tantalum.

name: Poincare
description: A terraformed world held stable by orbital mirrors.

name: Al'Kesh
description: A karst world whose cities are built in caverns beneath the surface. Six jump lanes meet here.

name: Inari
description: An old, eroded world, now an agricultural and industrial powerhouse.

name: Tempest
description: A metal-rich hothouse world.

name: San Jacinto
description: A hot, dry world rich in pharmaceutical resources.

name: Neos Athos
description: A harsh, sparsely populated world of monasteries.

name: Sweetwater
description: A cluster of habitats at a major jump-point nexus.

name: Aurora
description: A temperate, mostly ocean world in the habitable zone, home to some of the largest shipyards in the sector.

name: Techerlen
description: Once the Gem colony of Providence. The capital, Borealis City, sits on a mega-oasis at the north pole.

name: Otuken
description: Hot and tectonically active: high forested plateaus over desert lowlands. Homeworld of the avian Avesites.

name: Jangala
description: A deadly hothouse jungle world; its people live in corporate arcologies.

name: Quwamis
description: An ecumenopolis that appears abandoned.

name: Fullbright
description: Fullbright Station: a traffic-control terminal grown into a trade hub and space-city.
